recognize_zh: 視野中央的淋巴球細胞質邊緣可見數顆粉紫色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），核染色質濃縮、細胞質量中等，這就是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）的樣子。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte, roughly 1.5 times a red cell diameter
Round-to-oval nucleus with condensed chromatin, no visible nucleoli
Several coarse pink-purple azurophilic granules along the cytoplasmic rim
Background normochromic red cells with a few platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-intermediate power shows normochromic red cells and scattered platelets. A medium-sized lymphocyte with condensed nuclear chromatin and a moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm contains several coarse azurophilic granules. No blasts or nucleolated atypical lymphoid cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte; in the appropriate count context this supports an LGL (NK-cell) lymphocytosis, and immunophenotyping is needed to assign NK versus T lineage and clonality.

ddx.vs: Morphology cannot separate T-LGL from NK-LGL; flow cytometry (surface CD3 and TCR expression) and TCR gene rearrangement studies are required.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia shows larger atypical cells with open chromatin, visible nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm, usually EBV-positive in a sick patient.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and fine dust-like rather than coarse discrete granules.
